label: Bible Study
prompt: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is _____.
verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
note: Written from chains — Paul sees a win either way, living or dying.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Surely _____ and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verse: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
note: In the Shepherd Psalm, goodness and mercy don't just wait for you — they follow you, all the days.

label: Sunday School
prompt: In the sweat of thy _____ shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verse: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
note: Everyone says 'by the sweat of your brow,' but the KJV puts the sweat on Adam's face.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But we have this treasure in _____ vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verse: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
note: Gospel treasure in cheap clay pots — so no one mistakes the glow for the container.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking unto Jesus the author and _____ of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
verse: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
note: Jesus is 'the author and finisher' of faith — the one who starts it is the one who completes it.
